title: Spanish-Chamorro Wars on Guam
summary: After Jesuit missionaries led by Diego Luis de San Vitores arrived in 1668 and pressed Christianity on the CHamoru people, conflict broke out. San Vitores was killed in 1672, the military took over the mission, and fighting continued until about 1695. Spanish forces killed hundreds, and the population fell sharply.

uncertainty.note: Guampedia dates the arrival of the missionaries to 1668 and says the ensuing conflict lasted until 1695. Smithsonian Magazine says twenty-six years of wars followed San Vitores's 1672 death, which points to a slightly later end, so the end is shown with a few years of uncertainty. The id year 1670 is only a lookup key.
